purpose: Finish the entire declared scientific matrix after the original run was interrupted and retain all original evidence unchanged
reuse_rule: Reuse a history only if all 240 declared conditions and every exact declared request identity are present and reconcile, independent of recovery outcome and performance
fresh_capture_reason: Use current strict recorded execution environment and source contracts without bypassing guards
concurrency_qualification: Six separate case processes share one host and can contend; timings are descriptive rather than isolated comparative speedups
old_planner_records: Lost in-memory records are recomputed as metadata-only certificates and are explicitly not original measured planning times or original selected artifact identities
partial_forest_policy: Original partial forest rows and readable traces remain preserved but are not selected into the complete matrix; all forest conditions are rerun from fresh capture inputs
failures: Capture failures and solver unknowns remain recorded and cannot shrink the original declared grid
source_drift: Freeze an exact source snapshot before each measurement and record every source hash; changed source is a validation failure
